note: Proposed segmentation of the 144 entries that appear only on James list. Verdicts are hand-adjudicated and need review; the evidence for each is in the reason field. UDB baseline is the union of our 223-param snapshot and the 228 names in Jordan sail_udb_config_mapping.md, giving 229 distinct UDB parameters, which matches the count James reports.

CRITICAL_ERROR.reason: Critical-error signalling behaviour. UDB has no equivalent.

GEILEN.reason: Same quantity: number of supported guest external interrupts.

HSXLEN.reason: HS-mode XLEN. UDB models SXLEN, and separately VSXLEN/VUXLEN, without a distinct HSXLEN.

INTERRUPTS_ALLOWED_IN_PUSHPOP.reason: Whether interrupts may be taken during Zcmp push/pop sequences. UDB has no equivalent. Our pipeline found this and held it back under rule 1, because the sentence sits in a NOTE block. He includes it.

LRSC_ALIGNMENT.reason: His enum {AlwaysMisalignedExc, AlwaysAccessFaultExc, Other} is the same choice; Jordan maps Sail memory.misaligned.exceptions.lrsc to this UDB param.

MCAUSE_RST_ALIAS_OK.reason: Whether the mcause reset value may alias a defined cause. UDB models no CSR reset values.

MCAUSE_RST_VAL.reason: Reset value of mcause. UDB models no CSR reset values.

MEPC_INV_ADDR_CONV.reason: Invalid-address conversion on writes to mepc. UDB has no such parameter; our MNEPC_INVALID_ADDRESS_CONVERSION is the RNMI sibling.

MHARTID.reason: mhartid value. Jordan records platform.hartid as having no UDB parameter. Arguably platform rather than ISA; flagged rather than assumed.

MISALIGNED_LDST_EXC_TYPE.reason: Related but not identical: his is which exception type, UDB's is priority.

MSECCFG_MML_MMWP_RLB_RST.reason: Reset value of mseccfg MML/MMWP/RLB. UDB models no CSR reset values.

MSECCFG_USEED_SSEED_RST.reason: Reset value of the seed bits. Sail has Zkr.sseed_reset_value/useed_reset_value; Jordan records UDB as having neither.

MSIP_UPDATE_MAX_TIME.reason: A maximum time with no architectural units. Excluded by rule 6 (implementation-defined with no testable units or enumerable options).

MSTATUS_FS_IMPRECISE.reason: Adjacent aspect of the same FS dirty-tracking behaviour.

MSTATUS_FS_NO_CHANGE_DIRTY.reason: Adjacent aspect of the same FS dirty-tracking behaviour.

MSTATUS_SBE_ROCOPY.reason: mstatus.SBE as a read-only copy of MBE. This is the read-only-mirrors-another-bit WARL shape our own list treats as a parameter (cf. SSTATUS_UBE_ACCESS); UDB models only the endianness value.

MSTATUS_TW_TIME_LIMIT.reason: The WFI bounded time limit. Excluded by INCLUSION_CRITERIA rule 6, which names "bounded time limit" as its literal example of an implementation-defined quantity with no testable units.

MSTATUS_UBE_ROCOPY.reason: mstatus.UBE as a read-only copy of MBE. Same shape as MSTATUS_SBE_ROCOPY.

MSTATUS_VS_EXISTS.reason: Whether mstatus.VS exists when misa.V is clear. UDB has the VS-mode sibling VSSTATUS_VS_EXISTS but not the M-mode one.

MSTATUS_VS_NO_CHANGE_DIRTY.reason: Adjacent aspect of the same VS dirty-tracking behaviour.

MSTATUS_VS_SW_DIRTY_UPDATE.reason: Adjacent aspect of the same VS dirty-tracking behaviour.

MTIME_TICK_PERIOD.reason: Platform timing. Excluded by rule 4 (NON_ISA, outside ISA scope); Jordan records platform.clock_frequency and instructions_per_tick as having no UDB parameter either.

MTVAL2_TRAPVAL.reason: UDB splits by faulting operation; his is one entry.

MTVAL_INV_ADDR_CONV.reason: Invalid-address conversion on writes to mtval. UDB has no such parameter.

MTVAL_PER_EXC_BEHAVIOR.reason: UDB has 14 REPORT_*_IN_MTVAL_ON_* parameters; his is one per-exception umbrella. 1-to-many.

MTVEC_RDONLY.reason: UDB's MTVEC_ACCESS enumerates read-only vs writable.

NMI_ADDR.reason: NMI vector address. Excluded by rule 4 (NON_ISA, platform rather than ISA), not on testability grounds -- it is observable. Scope question for the mentor.

NMI_MCAUSE_VAL.reason: mcause value on NMI. UDB models no NMI cause value.

NTL_TRAP_BEHAVIOR.reason: Trap behaviour for NTL hints. UDB has TRAP_ON_RESERVED_INSTRUCTION but nothing NTL-specific.

PMA_CACHE_MM_ALL_ATOMICS.reason: Whether cacheable main memory supports all atomics. Same PMA gap.

PMA_MM_IFETCH.reason: Whether main-memory regions support instruction fetch. UDB has PMA_GRANULARITY only; Jordan records UDB as having no per-region PMA attributes.

PMA_MO_DYN.reason: Whether memory-ordering PMAs are dynamically configurable. Same PMA gap.

PMP_A_L_RST.reason: Reset value of pmpcfg A and L fields. UDB models no CSR reset values.

PMP_GRANULARITY.reason: Exact name match. Note Jordan flags a units transform vs Sail (G vs G+2).

RST_ADDR.reason: Reset vector address. Excluded by rule 4 (NON_ISA, platform rather than ISA), not on testability grounds -- it is observable. Scope question for the mentor.

SATP_MODE_ROZ_SFENCE_ILLEGAL.reason: Same concept; Jordan maps the Sail equivalent to this UDB param.

TIME_CSR_HW_SUPPORT.reason: Same question: does a real hardware time CSR exist.

VECTOR_FF_SEG_SUBSET_EXC_ON_ZEROTH.reason: He splits the zeroth-element case out; UDB has one parameter.

VECTOR_FF_SEG_SUBSET_EXC_PAST_ZEROTH.reason: He splits the past-zeroth case out; UDB has one parameter.

VECTOR_LS_CONSTANT_STRIDE_X0.reason: Constant-stride vector load/store with rs2=x0. UDB has no equivalent.

VECTOR_LS_VSTART.reason: UDB enumerates legal vstart values; his is the load/store-specific rule.

WFI_OPT_U_MODE.reason: Whether WFI is available in U-mode. Jordan records platform.wfi_available_to_user_mode as having no UDB parameter. NOTE: our own WFI_U_MODE was rejected by the mentor as a duplicate, so this needs his ruling.

WFI_RESUME_REASON.reason: What may cause WFI to resume. UDB has no WFI resume parameter.

ZILSD_ALIGN8_ATOMIC.reason: Whether 8-byte-aligned Zilsd accesses are atomic. UDB has no equivalent.

ctrsource.reason: WARL behaviour of ctrsource. UDB has MCTRCTL_* field parameters but nothing for the entry registers.

hedeleg.reason: Delegatable-bit mask of hedeleg. Verified: UDB has no parameter touching any interrupt-pending, interrupt-enable or delegation register.

henvcfg.CBIE.reason: UDB's param controls CBIE=0b11 only; Jordan notes it is related but not the same as the reserved 0b10 behaviour.

hgainp.MODE.reason: hgatp.MODE (his reg-name is a typo for hgatp). UDB splits this MODE field into GSTAGE_MODE_BARE plus one boolean per SvNNx4 translation mode.

hgeie.reason: Writable-bit mask of hgeie. Verified: UDB has no parameter touching any interrupt-pending, interrupt-enable or delegation register.

hideleg.reason: Delegatable-bit mask of hideleg. Verified: UDB has no parameter touching any interrupt-pending, interrupt-enable or delegation register.

hie.reason: Writable-bit mask of hie. Verified: UDB has no parameter touching any interrupt-pending, interrupt-enable or delegation register.

hstateen0/hstateen1/hstateen2/hstateen3.reason: UDB models one parameter per named hstateen bit.

hstatus.VGEIN.reason: VGEIN's legal range is bounded by GEILEN, which UDB models as a count rather than a field constraint.

htinst.reason: UDB has 14 TINST_VALUE_ON_* parameters, one per exception; his is one register-level WARL entry. 1-to-many.

hvip.reason: Writable-bit mask of hvip. Verified: UDB has no parameter touching any interrupt-pending, interrupt-enable or delegation register.

jvt.MODE.reason: UDB captures jvt writability but not the MODE legal-value set.

mcause.EXCCODE.reason: WLRL legal exception codes of mcause. UDB has no cause-code legal-value parameter.

menvcfg.PMM.reason: UDB models PMLEN as a configured integer rather than per-CSR PMM field legal values.

mepc.reason: WARL behaviour of mepc. UDB has no mepc parameter; our SEPC_INVALID_ADDR_BEHAVIOR is the sepc sibling.

mhpmcounter.reason: UDB models which counters exist as a bit vector; his is the register-level WARL.

mhpmevent.reason: UDB enumerates legal event numbers; his is the register-level WARL.

mie.reason: Writable-bit mask of mie. Verified: UDB has no parameter touching any interrupt-pending, interrupt-enable or delegation register.

misa.EXTENSIONS.reason: UDB splits misa writability into one boolean per extension bit.

miselect.reason: Supported value range of miselect. UDB has no iselect parameter; our SISELECT_WIDTH and VSISELECT_WIDTH are the s/vs siblings.

mncause.reason: WARL behaviour of mncause (RNMI). UDB has no mncause parameter.

mnstatus.reason: WARL behaviour of mnstatus (RNMI). UDB has no mnstatus parameter.

mseccfg.MML.reason: WARL behaviour of mseccfg.MML. UDB has no mseccfg field parameters.

mseccfg.MMWP.reason: WARL behaviour of mseccfg.MMWP. UDB has no mseccfg field parameters.

mseccfg.RLB.reason: WARL behaviour of mseccfg.RLB. UDB has no mseccfg field parameters.

mstatus.MDT.reason: WARL behaviour of mstatus.MDT (Smdbltrp). UDB has no MDT parameter.

mstatus.MPP.reason: Legal values of mstatus.MPP. UDB models no MPP legal-value set.

mstatus.SPP.reason: Legal values of mstatus.SPP. UDB models no SPP legal-value set.

mstatus.TSR.reason: WARL behaviour of mstatus.TSR. UDB has MSTATUS_TVM_IMPLEMENTED but no TSR equivalent.

mstatus.TW.reason: WARL behaviour of mstatus.TW. UDB has MSTATUS_TVM_IMPLEMENTED but no TW equivalent.

mtval.reason: Implemented-bit mask of mtval is UDB's MTVAL_WIDTH.

mtvec.BASE.reason: UDB splits BASE alignment by mode.

pmpcfgN.pmpMcfg.reason: UDB splits pmpcfg.A legal values into per-mode booleans.

scause.EXCEPTION_CODE.reason: WLRL legal exception codes of scause. UDB has no cause-code legal-value parameter.

sctrdepth.DEPTH.reason: Duplicates his own SCTRDEPTH_DEPTH parameter_definition (same field, recorded once in each section). That parameter already matches our SCTRDEPTH_SUPPORTED_VALUES.

sctrstatus.WRPTR.reason: WARL behaviour of sctrstatus.WRPTR. UDB has no sctrstatus parameter.

sie.reason: Writable-bit mask of sie. Verified: UDB has no parameter touching any interrupt-pending, interrupt-enable or delegation register.

sstateen0/sstateen1/sstateen2/sstateen3.reason: UDB models only the JVT bit at S level, while mstateen/hstateen have six each.

sstatus.SDT.reason: WARL behaviour of sstatus.SDT (Ssdbltrp). UDB has no SDT parameter.

stval.reason: Implemented-bit mask of stval is UDB's STVAL_WIDTH.

stvec.BASE.reason: BASE alignment of stvec. Jordan records explicitly that UDB has no STVEC base-alignment parameter while Sail does.

stvec.MODE.reason: UDB splits MODE into one boolean per legal mode.

vsatp.MODE.reason: UDB splits vsatp.MODE across per-mode booleans plus an illegal-write behaviour.

vscause.reason: WLRL legal exception codes of vscause. UDB has no cause-code legal-value parameter.

vsepc.reason: WARL behaviour of vsepc. UDB has no vsepc parameter; our SEPC_INVALID_ADDR_BEHAVIOR is the sepc sibling.

vsie.reason: Writable-bit mask of vsie. Verified: UDB has no parameter touching any interrupt-pending, interrupt-enable or delegation register.

vsip.reason: Writable-bit mask of vsip. Verified: UDB has no parameter touching any interrupt-pending, interrupt-enable or delegation register.

vstval.reason: Implemented-bit width of vstval. UDB has MTVAL_WIDTH and STVAL_WIDTH but no VSTVAL_WIDTH.

vstvec.BASE.reason: UDB has no vstvec BASE-alignment parameter; Jordan records the same gap for stvec.

vstvec.MODE.reason: UDB splits the MODE field into one boolean per legal mode.
